from pathlib import Path
import subprocess, os, re

wt=Path("/Users/steventran/.do_again/lifecycle-ci-20261007")
base="cbf5f56a41d3a61a33b4b3ea873d93461d4fc232"

def run(args,check=True,env=None):
    return subprocess.run(args,cwd=wt,text=True,capture_output=True,check=check,env=env)

if run(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"]).stdout.strip()!=base:
    raise SystemExit("unexpected head")
status=run(["git","status","--porcelain=v1"]).stdout
expected_dirty={
    "src/do_again/core/schema.py",
    "src/do_again/service/liveness.py",
    "tests/test_liveness.py",
    "tests/test_request_fingerprints.py",
}
actual={line[3:] for line in status.splitlines() if len(line)>=4}
if actual!=expected_dirty:
    raise SystemExit(f"unexpected dirty set: {actual}")

schema=(wt/"src/do_again/core/schema.py").read_text()
if "class OperatorError" not in schema and "OperatorError =" not in schema:
    raise SystemExit("OperatorError not defined in schema.py")

p=wt/"tests/test_request_fingerprints.py"
t=p.read_text()
old_import="from do_again.core.schema import atomic_json, request_fingerprint, utc_now, validate_request"
new_import="from do_again.core.schema import OperatorError, atomic_json, request_fingerprint, utc_now, validate_request"
if old_import not in t:
    raise SystemExit("expected import anchor missing")
t=t.replace(old_import,new_import,1)
t=t.replace("normalized = normalize_request(request)","normalized = validate_request(request, max_ttl_seconds=3600)",1)
t=t.replace("normalize_request(request)","validate_request(request, max_ttl_seconds=3600)",1)
p.write_text(t)

env=os.environ.copy()
env["PYTHONPATH"]=str(wt/"src")
focused=run([
    "python3","-m","unittest",
    "tests.test_liveness",
    "tests.test_request_fingerprints",
    "tests.test_operator_progress",
],check=False,env=env)
print("=== focused stdout ===")
print(focused.stdout)
print("=== focused stderr ===")
print(focused.stderr)
print("focused_rc="+str(focused.returncode))
if focused.returncode:
    raise SystemExit(focused.returncode)

compile=run([
    "python3","-m","py_compile",
    "src/do_again/core/schema.py",
    "src/do_again/service/liveness.py",
    "tests/test_liveness.py",
    "tests/test_request_fingerprints.py",
],check=False,env=env)
print("compile_rc="+str(compile.returncode))
print(compile.stderr)
if compile.returncode:
    raise SystemExit(compile.returncode)

run(["git","add",
     "src/do_again/core/schema.py",
     "src/do_again/service/liveness.py",
     "tests/test_liveness.py",
     "tests/test_request_fingerprints.py"])
commit=run(["git","commit","-m","Resume durable CI wait lifecycle"],check=False)
print(commit.stdout)
print(commit.stderr)
print("commit_rc="+str(commit.returncode))
if commit.returncode:
    raise SystemExit(commit.returncode)

print("head="+run(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"]).stdout.strip())
print("status_after="+repr(run(["git","status","--porcelain=v1"]).stdout))
